1. Monitor your temperature regularly and note any significant changes.
2. Stay hydrated by drinking plenty of fluids.
3. Rest as much as possible to help your body recover.
4. Use over-the-counter medications like acetaminophen or ibuprofen to manage fever and discomfort, following the dosage instructions on the label.
5. If your cough becomes more severe or you experience increased shortness of breath, seek medical attention promptly.
6. Avoid smoking and exposure to irritants that could worsen your cough.
7. Follow up with your healthcare provider if symptoms do not improve within a few days or if you develop new symptoms.
